sources.snippet: ⚠️ For contrast, the other public ROCmFP4 build of this model (julianmb/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-ROCmFP4-GGUF, ftype 106) ships Q5_K token embeddings and a 4-bit output.weight, while its card states "FP16 embedding/norm preservation". We read both headers with two independent parsers. Head protection is not implied by an ftype name — it has to be requested and then verified in the file.

sources.title: GitHub - charlie12345/rocmfp4: ROCmfp4 · GitHub
sources.snippet: ROCmFP4 is an experimental GGUF quantization and backend integration package for AMD ROCm and Vulkan llama.cpp builds. This repository is the clean integration package.

sources.title: GitHub - charlie12345/ROCmFPX: ROCmFPX Family for AMD Hardware and ...
sources.snippet: ROCmFPX adds experimental AMD-focused 2-, 3-, 4-, 6-, and 8-bit GGUF model-weight formats to llama.cpp, with CPU reference paths and accelerated HIP/ROCm and Vulkan kernels. Status: ROCmFPX is an experimental feature family on the canonical main branch. APIs, tuning choices, and performance can change.
